他迷迷糊糊的跑到桌子旁，拿着水壶倒了半天也没倒出一滴，不由一怔，揉了揉眼睛四下一看，发现被褥都干巴巴的皱成一团，呆呆对王林说道：“王林，你啥时候回来的，咱家这是……闹旱鬼了？”
王林苦笑，推开房门，说道：“我也不知道，回来时就这样，要不你问问其他师兄吧，不过若是传到长老那里，你少不了解释的麻烦，没准还要盘问一番。”
张虎使劲摇了摇脑袋，说道：“得了，我可不说，不然准会被问来问去，一个回答不好少不了要挨训。”
王林也没理他，走出房门，此时外面还是下着小雨，他略一沉吟，急匆匆走出，担心珠子会引起雨水异象，他专挑一些小路，左绕右绕的从东门出去，路上所有落在身上的水滴都被神秘珠子吸收，他颇为紧张，生怕被人发现异常，之前他本打算藏在房间里，可仔细一想便放弃，认为还是藏在外面保险一些。
一路来到藏露水葫芦的地方，好在此时天色并未大亮，早起的人不多，王林行走间极为小心，确定无人后他飞快把珠子藏在此地。
做完这些，他松了口气，他打算等雨停了，再来把宝贝拿走，四下看了看，王林谨慎的离开。来到杂务处后，他正要拿起水桶，这时刘姓弟子的房门“吱嘎”一声被推开，露出对方那副尖嘴猴腮的黄鼠狼脸，他看到王林后一怔，脸上顿时涌现热情之色，上前抢过王林手中的水桶，嘴上说道：“这不是王师弟么，怎么样，家里父母身体都还好吧，你走这几天，师兄我心里一直挂念啊。”
王林一怔，对方的嘴脸他很熟悉，与自家亲戚一般无二，但是他想不明白，这姓刘的今天唱的是哪出。
“刘师兄，我爹娘身体都还好，不劳你关心了。”猜不出对方想法，王林谨慎的说道。
“师弟啊，你以后不用每天都起的这么早，师弟，不是我说你，之前师兄和你开玩笑，让你一天打十缸水，你倒实在，还真相信了，以后啊，一天一缸水就行，而且也甭管打没打满，到了吃饭的时间你就去吃饭，要是有人为难你，你就报上师兄的名字，好使！”刘姓弟子拍着胸口，极其热情的说道。
王林目露古怪之色，犹豫了一下，问道：“师兄，你是不是有什么事情要我去办？”
刘姓弟子立刻露出不满之色，假装生气道：“师弟，怎么和师兄这么见外，师兄难道就是那么市侩的人嘛，你是我师弟，我对你好是天经地义的嘛，以后你的事就是我的事，这平时的工作，意思一下就行了，到时候干的好坏，还不是师兄我一句话嘛，今天下雨，你就甭干活了，对了，师弟，前几天孙长老找你，你现在回来了，还是去长老那里报到一下为好。”说完，他斜着眼睛看王林如何反应。
王林略一沉吟，脸上露出似笑非笑的表情，心里猜测出大半原因，听对方的意思，孙长老在自己走后定是到他这里来找到自己，这姓刘的怕是有所误会，所以今天才百般讨好。他也不点破，学着当初对方的样子，鼻子里发出“恩”的一声。
刘姓弟子一看王林表情，内心咯噔一下，更加确定自己的猜测，暗道这废物小子定是走了狗屎运，居然真搭上了长老，不然也不会这么狂妄。这小子一看就是特别记仇的那种人，以前对他刁难，日后这小子准会整自己。
他成为记名弟子十三年了，在杂务处也有六年，还从来没看到哪个长老肯亲自来寻找一个记名弟子。平日里哪怕是派个内门弟子前来，也都是了不得的事情了。
他也不是没想过王林可能得罪了长老，并非如自己猜测那般，但他不确定啊，他不怕一万只怕万一，在恒岳派多年，他深知这里面水很深，自己一个小小记名弟子，实在是太微不足道了。
想到这里，他狠狠一咬牙，从怀里拿出一张黄纸，塞给王林，说道：“师弟啊，师兄上个月一看见你，就一见如故，这小小礼物不成敬意，你说什么也要收下，你若不要……”
没等他说完，王林一把抓过黄纸，他刚才眼神一扫，立刻发现这是一张记名弟子探亲用的仙符。
“好说，师兄好意，师弟就却之不恭了，不过长老正在等我，明日师弟再来与师兄叙旧吧。”王林轻笑，说道。

He ran to the table in a daze, and poured the kettle for a long time without pouring out a drop. He couldn't help but be startled, rubbed his eyes and looked around, and found that the bedding was all dry and wrinkled. He said to Wang Lin blankly: "Wang Lin, when did you come back? Is our house... drought haunted?"
Wang Lin smiled bitterly, pushed open the door, and said, "I don't know. It was just like this when I came back. Why don't you ask other senior brothers? But if it reaches the elders, you will have trouble explaining it, and you may have to cross-examine it."
Zhang Hu shook his head vigorously and said: "Come on, I won't say anything, otherwise I will be questioned again and again. If you don't answer well, you will inevitably be punished."
Wang Lin ignored him and walked out of the room. It was still raining lightly outside. He pondered for a moment and hurried out. He was worried that the beads would cause rain phenomena. He chose some small paths and went out from the east door in a detour. All the water droplets that fell on him were absorbed by the mysterious beads. He was quite nervous, fearing that someone would notice something unusual. He had originally planned to hide in the room, but after thinking about it carefully, he gave up and thought it would be safer to hide outside.
All the way to the place where the dew water hyacinth was hidden, fortunately it was not bright yet, and there were not many people getting up early. Wang Lin was very careful when walking, and after making sure that no one was around, he quickly hid the beads here.
After doing this, he breathed a sigh of relief. He planned to wait for the rain to stop before taking the treasure away. After looking around, Wang Lin left cautiously. After arriving at the chore office, he was about to pick up the bucket when the door of the disciple surnamed Liu was pushed open with a creak, revealing a weasel face with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks. He was startled when he saw Wang Lin, and a look of enthusiasm suddenly appeared on his face. He stepped forward and snatched the bucket from Wang Lin's hand, and said, "Isn't this Junior Brother Wang? How about it? My parents are in good health at home. I have been thinking about you Senior Brother these days since you left."
Wang Lin was startled. He knew the other person's face very well, just like his own relatives, but he couldn't figure out where Liu was singing today.
"Senior Brother Liu, my parents are in good health, so I don't need to worry about you anymore." Wang Lin said cautiously, unable to guess what the other party was thinking.
"Junior brother, you don't have to get up so early every day. Junior brother, I'm not talking about you. My senior brother joked with you before and asked you to fetch ten tanks of water a day. You actually believed it. From now on, one tank of water a day is enough, and it doesn't matter whether it is full. When it's time to eat, you go to eat. If someone gives you trouble, you just tell your senior brother's name. That's fine!" Disciple surnamed Liu patted his chest and said with great enthusiasm.
Wang Lin had a strange look on his face, hesitated for a moment, and asked, "Senior brother, do you have something you want me to do?"
The disciple surnamed Liu immediately showed a dissatisfied look and pretended to be angry: "Junior brother, why are you so alienated from your senior brother? Is he such a philistine person? You are my junior brother. It is only natural that I treat you well. From now on, your business is my business. This daily work, please excuse me. That's all. It's up to you, senior brother, to see if you do well or not. If it rains today, don't do any work. By the way, junior brother, Elder Sun came to see you a few days ago. Now that you're back, you'd better report to the elder." After saying that, he squinted his eyes to see how Wang Lin would react.
Wang Lin pondered for a moment, with a half-smiling expression on his face. He guessed most of the reasons in his heart. Listening to what the other party meant, Elder Sun must have come to him to find him after he left. The man named Liu was afraid that he might have misunderstood, so he tried every means to please him today. He didn't point it out. He imitated the other party's behavior and said "en" from his nose.
When the disciple surnamed Liu saw Wang Lin's expression, his heart skipped a beat, and he became more sure of his guess. He secretly thought that this good-for-nothing boy must have been lucky enough to actually fall in love with the elder, otherwiseHe wouldn't be so arrogant. This kid seems to be the kind of person who holds a special grudge. If he made things difficult for him in the past, he will definitely make trouble for himself in the future.
He has been a registered disciple for thirteen years and has been in the miscellaneous affairs office for six years, but he has never seen an elder willing to personally look for a registered disciple. Normally, even sending an inner disciple here would be a big deal.
It wasn't like he hadn't thought that Wang Lin might have offended the elder, not as he had guessed, but he was not sure. He was not afraid of ten thousand, just in case. He had been in the Hengyue Sect for many years, and he knew that the water was very deep here. He, a small registered disciple, was really insignificant.
Thinking of this, he gritted his teeth, took out a piece of yellow paper from his arms, stuffed it into Wang Lin, and said, "Junior brother, I fell in love with you as soon as I saw you last month. This small gift is not respectful. You have to accept it no matter what. If you don't want it..."
Before he could finish speaking, Wang Lin grabbed the yellow paper. He glanced at it and immediately realized that it was an immortal talisman used by named disciples to visit relatives.
"It's easy to say that my brother is disrespectful of my brother's kindness, but the elder is waiting for me. I'll come back tomorrow to catch up with him." Wang Lin said with a chuckle.
